commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

The ball falls for Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there! The referee points to the corner flag and Dortmund will take a corner.

90' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

90' The corner from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is intercepted by the defence.
